scope: Emulator integration evidence; not hardware performance or save-format verification

recording.scope: Sampled at the emulator frontend clock; not measured hardware performance

live_input.semantics: CSV until first accepted live packet; then complete live override, expiring to neutral
live_input.sequence: Strictly increasing positive uint64; repeated/stale packets never renew duration
live_input.clock: Accepted at the next frontend frame before retro_run; duration counts frontend frames
